diagnostic_confound_not_dismissed.question_open: The diagnostic source/target kernel paths, GPI NULL-fix/trace, and retained GCC/UFS/PHY changes remain possible contributors. This raw audit cannot exonerate any of them or establish a unique underlying hardware cause.
diagnostic_confound_not_dismissed.ABI_limit: Matching CRC/layout or static control-flow checks test compatibility and narrow implementation properties, not correctness of every enabled runtime path.
diagnostic_confound_not_dismissed.cold_boot_limit: The earlier ordinary same-Image control used diagnostic guards off and stock modules; it cannot serve as an equivalent execution test of kexec-only diagnostics and the four altered module paths.
diagnostic_confound_not_dismissed.no_missing_marker_inference: No44f9/KGPICMD1 does not prove new GPI was not adopted, nor does it prove it ran successfully. No panic does not prove absence of panic or successful NULL-timeout fix.

conclusion: Automatic transition to observed fastboot is supported by the user confirmation plus USB mode observation; its mechanism, current-target runtime identity, first failure, new-GPI adoption and involvement of diagnostic changes remain undetermined. Later stock success only establishes recovery availability.
